description: Create docs/migration.md documenting what existing code maps to what in the new architecture (Task #2 from spec). Also update packages/core to align with the new data contract - rewrite s3-keys.ts, duration.ts, and related modules to use the new manifest structure.
steps: Inventory all existing constructs in infra/lib/ and map them to new spec: storage-construct (keep), auth-construct (keep), api-construct (rebuild routes per section 5), marp-lambda-construct (keep for slide gen), polly-worker-construct (keep), render-state-machine-construct (rebuild as 5-stage pipeline), content-state-machine-construct (rebuild for new flow), teaser-* (remove - not in spec), delivery-construct (keep), frontend-construct (keep), composition-builder-construct (remove/replace with clips stage), slide-generator-construct (keep for outline gen)

Inventory all existing lambdas and map: api (rebuild routes per section 5), marp-render (keep, adapt), polly-worker (keep, change output to MP3), render-worker (rebuild as per-page clip generator), slide-generator (keep for outline+deck gen), composition-builder (replace with concat stage), teaser-* (remove)

Inventory packages: shared-types (rebuilt in FEAT-001), core (rebuild s3-keys + duration for new layout), renderer-port (simplify interface for new pipeline), renderer-ffmpeg (rebuild for clip+concat per section 6), renderer-contract-tests (update), renderer-hyperframes (remove - not in spec), evaluation (remove - not in spec)
Write docs/migration.md with a clear table: existing item -> new mapping -> action (keep/rebuild/remove)
Rewrite packages/core/src/s3-keys.ts to match section 4.1 S3 layout: users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/ with input/, deck/, pages/, audio/, captions/, clips/, output/{renderId}/ paths
Rewrite packages/core/src/duration.ts for the new model: audioDurationSec is per-page ffprobe measurement, total is sum of all pages
Update packages/core unit tests to match new s3-keys and duration logic
Ensure packages/core builds and tests pass
acceptance_criteria: docs/migration.md exists with a table covering all existing constructs, lambdas, and packages
Teaser-related code is identified for removal in migration.md
findings: All 47 tests pass. Build succeeds. Core now depends on shared-types S3 key builders (re-exports + convenience helpers). Duration model changed from ms-based with lead-in/lead-out to simple seconds-based audioDurationSec. New script-hash module added for cost control. Captions simplified to SRT-only generation from manifest pages. Removed: audio/ (PCM), manifest/ (old builder), teaser/ (not in spec). CJS Vite deprecation warning is cosmetic only.
